description: This file declares the ActiveRequests class, which manages active media requests within the Rialto server component. It includes nested classes, methods for managing request lifecycle, and data structures for tracking media segments.

classes.name: ActiveRequests
classes.description: Manages active media requests, allowing insertion, removal, and segment management.

classes.name: ActiveRequests::ActiveRequestsData
classes.description: Holds data for a specific media request, including its type, segments, and byte counts.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Adds a new media request with specified source type and maximum media bytes.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the media source type for a given request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a request by request ID or media source type.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to a specific request.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Retrieves all media segments associated with a request.
